## Summary

- `js2path` no longer removes movetos; it only serializes;
`convertPathData` now leaves consecutive movetos to `collapseRepeated`,
which already merges them, and keeps them when `collapseRepeated` is
disabled or the path has mid markers
- `mergePaths` now does the applicable part itself (drop movetos that
end the first path being merged since the second path will have its own
moveto) since it runs after `convertPathData` now that `js2path` no
longer does this

## Motivation

`js2path` removed every moveto that was followed by another moveto. When
the following moveto was relative, it was then measured from the wrong
point, and everything after it moved:

```js
optimize('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M10 10M15 15h1"/></svg>', {
  plugins: [{ name: 'convertPathData', params: { collapseRepeated: false } }],
});
// before: <path d="m5 5h1"/>
// after:  <path d="M10 10m5 5h1"/>
```

The input is absolute, but `convertPathData` converts it to relative
before writing it. The same thing happens with `marker-mid`, including
`marker-mid="none"`, and in `mergePaths` (`<path d="M10 10m5 5h1"/><path
d="M30 30h1"/>` became `m5 5h1M30 30h1`).

I ran into this through #2314: there, `marker:none` counts as a mid
marker, so `collapseRepeated` was skipped and
`oxygen-icons-5.116.0/scalable/apps/calligrasheets.svg` had a path move
by about 167 units (`m166.669,34.988 z m -5.657,-5.657 …` became
`m-5.6568-5.6568…`).

`convertPathData` already merges consecutive movetos in
`collapseRepeated`, and `convertToMixed` never removes commands. So the
only pairs that reached `js2path` were the ones `collapseRepeated` had
kept on purpose: it was disabled, or the path had mid markers. Keeping
the movetos in those cases is also correct for rendering. In Chromium,
every moveto is a marker vertex: `M10 10M30 30M50 50h20` with
`marker-mid` draws markers at 30,30 and 50,50, so removing a moveto
drops a marker. Without markers, a moveto followed by another moveto
draws nothing, even with round line caps.

For `mergePaths`, the parsed data of every path starts with an absolute
moveto, including the data cached by `convertPathData`. So a moveto that
ends the previous path can be removed when the next one starts, which
keeps `mergePaths.02` passing. Movetos inside a single path are now left
as they are. In `preset-default`, `convertPathData` runs before
`mergePaths` and has already merged them.

Output only changes for paths that had consecutive movetos and were not
collapsed by `collapseRepeated`. These get slightly larger but correct.
The `marker-mid="none"` case is one of them, because `convertPathData`
treats any `marker-mid` value as a marker.

## Verification

- 3 new fixtures with one case each, all failing on `main` because a
moveto moves:
- `convertPathData.41`: `collapseRepeated: false` (`M0 0h10M20 20m5 5h1`
became `M0 0h10m5 5h1`)
- `convertPathData.42`: `marker-mid` (`M10 10M50 50h20` became `m40
40h20`)
- `mergePaths.13`: a relative moveto inside a merged path (`M10 10m5
5h1` + `M30 30h1` became `m5 5h1M30 30h1`)
- `calligrasheets.svg` from oxygen-icons v5.116.0 optimizes
byte-identically to `main` with this branch alone; with #2314 on top,
the affected path keeps its position
- `pnpm test` (523 passed, 3 skipped)
- `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm spellcheck`, `pnpm test:bundles`
- `git diff --check`
